How do I use it properly the very first time?
To get the best fit the very first time, put the bra on like a t-shirt by stepping into it or pulling it over your head, then settle the band smooth across your ribcage.
Reach inside each cup to lift and position your bust into the internal cups so you are centered and supported. Finally, adjust the straps and back hook-and-eye closure so it feels snug yet weightless with zero digging!
